desc:
🎃 Welcome to Lift a Pumpkin!

How big a pumpkin can you lift? Grab your dumbbells, build your strength, and take on heavier pumpkins as you work toward your personal record!

💪 Train to gain muscle and tackle bigger lifting challenges.
🎲 Roll for better dumbbells and improve your training setup.
⭐ Level up and progress through different pumpkin stages.
🌙 Earn strength offline and return ready for your workout.
🔄 Rebirth to continue your progression.
🎁 Collect daily rewards and keep your goals moving.
👥 Play with friends and enjoy the friend boost!

Start small, get stronger, and turn huge pumpkins into your next achievement. Choose your next target, test your strength, and see how far you can go!

Explore luck boosts, muscle packs, Golden Rolls, and other shop options as you build a lifting routine.

👍 Like and favorite the game if you enjoy it, and join Cornlit Games to follow our experiences.

Your next lift is waiting. Start training and become a pumpkin lifting legend! 🏆
